    77	}
    78	
    79	inline double pointDistance(const Point& first, const Point& second) {
    80	    const double dx = first.x - second.x;
    81	    const double dy = first.y - second.y;
    82	    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    83	}
    84	
    85	__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterCandidate(double lhs_distance, int lhs,
    86	                                                 double rhs_distance, int rhs) {
    87	    return lhs_distance < rhs_distance ||
    88	           (lhs_distance == rhs_distance && lhs < rhs);
    89	}
    90	
    91	// A block builds one candidate cluster. Maintaining the maximum distance of
    92	// every point incrementally reduces candidate construction from cubic to
    93	// quadratic work. Threads cooperate on distance updates and deterministic
    94	// minimum selection; independent seeds fill the GPU concurrently.
    95	__global__ void buildCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,
    96	                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
    97	                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,
    98	                                       int seed_count, int point_count,
    99	                                       double threshold,
   100	                                       double* __restrict__ max_distances,
   101	                                       int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
   102	                                       int* __restrict__ output_members) {
   103	    const int seed_slot = blockIdx.x;
   104	    if (seed_slot >= seed_count)
   105	        return;
   106	
   107	    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
   108	    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
   109	    __shared__ int selected;
   110	    __shared__ int cardinality;
   111	
   112	    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
   113	    const int seed = seeds[seed_slot];
   114	    double* const seed_distances =
   115	        max_distances + static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count;
   116	
   117	    for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
   118	         candidate += blockDim.x) {
   119	        if (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) {
   120	            seed_distances[candidate] = DBL_MAX;
   121	        } else {
   122	            const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[seed].x;
   123	            const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[seed].y;
   124	            seed_distances[candidate] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   125	        }
   126	    }
   127	    if (thread == 0) {
   128	        cardinality = 1;
   129	        if (output_members)
   130	            output_members[0] = seed;
   131	    }
   132	    __syncthreads();
   133	
   134	    while (cardinality < point_count) {
   135	        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
   136	        int local_index = INT_MAX;
   137	        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
   138	             candidate += blockDim.x) {
   139	            const double candidate_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
   140	            if (candidate_distance < threshold &&
   141	                betterCandidate(candidate_distance, candidate,
   142	                                local_distance, local_index)) {
   143	                local_distance = candidate_distance;
   144	                local_index = candidate;
   145	            }
   146	        }
   147	        reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
   148	        reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
   149	        __syncthreads();
   150	
   151	        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
   152	            if (thread < stride &&
   153	                betterCandidate(reduction_distance[thread + stride],
   154	                                reduction_index[thread + stride],
   155	                                reduction_distance[thread],
   156	                                reduction_index[thread])) {
   157	                reduction_distance[thread] = reduction_distance[thread + stride];
   158	                reduction_index[thread] = reduction_index[thread + stride];
   159	            }
   160	            __syncthreads();
   161	        }
   162	
   163	        if (thread == 0) {
   164	            selected = reduction_index[0] == INT_MAX ? -1 : reduction_index[0];
   165	            if (selected >= 0) {
   166	                if (output_members)
   167	                    output_members[cardinality] = selected;
   168	                ++cardinality;
   169	                seed_distances[selected] = DBL_MAX;
   170	            }
   171	        }
   172	        __syncthreads();
   173	        if (selected < 0)
   174	            break;
   175	
   176	        const Point added = points[selected];
   177	        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
   178	             candidate += blockDim.x) {
   179	            const double old_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
   180	            if (old_distance != DBL_MAX) {
   181	                const double dx = points[candidate].x - added.x;
   182	                const double dy = points[candidate].y - added.y;
   183	                const double new_distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   184	                seed_distances[candidate] =
   185	                    new_distance > old_distance ? new_distance : old_distance;
   186	            }
   187	        }
   188	        __syncthreads();
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    if (thread == 0)
   192	        cardinalities[seed_slot] = cardinality;
   193	}
   194	
   195	class CudaCandidateEngine {
   196	public:
   197	    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, int maximum_seed_count)
   198	        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {
   199	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_points_, points.size() * sizeof(Point)));
   200	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_, points.size()));
   201	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),
   202	                              points.size() * sizeof(Point),
   203	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   204	
   205	        size_t free_bytes = 0;
   206	        size_t total_bytes = 0;
   207	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
   208	        (void)total_bytes;
   209	        const size_t bytes_per_seed = points.size() * sizeof(double);
   210	        const size_t memory_limited = bytes_per_seed == 0
   211	                                          ? 1
   212	                                          : (free_bytes / 2) / bytes_per_seed;
   213	        capacity_ = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
   214	            static_cast<size_t>(maximum_seed_count),
   215	            std::min<size_t>(memory_limited, 65535)));
   216	
   217	        // Fragmentation can make cudaMemGetInfo optimistic. Back off cleanly.
   218	        cudaError_t allocation_error = cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
   219	        while (capacity_ > 0) {
   220	            allocation_error = cudaMalloc(
   230	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
   231	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, points.size() * sizeof(int)));
   232	    }
   233	
   234	    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
   235	        cudaFree(device_members_);
   236	        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
   237	        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
   238	        cudaFree(device_max_distances_);
   239	        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
   240	        cudaFree(device_points_);
   241	    }
   242	
   243	    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
   244	    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
   245	
   246	    std::pair<int, int> bestLocalSeed(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
   247	                                      const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,
   248	                                      double threshold) {
   249	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
   250	                              clustered.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   251	        int best_cardinality = -1;
   252	        int best_seed = INT_MAX;
   253	
   254	        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < seeds.size(); offset += capacity_) {
   255	            const int batch_count = static_cast<int>(
   256	                std::min(capacity_, seeds.size() - offset));
   257	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data() + offset,
   258	                                  batch_count * sizeof(int),
   259	                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   260	            buildCandidateClusters<<<batch_count, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
   261	                device_points_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_, batch_count,
   262	                point_count_, threshold, device_max_distances_,
   263	                device_cardinalities_, nullptr);
   264	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   265	
   266	            host_cardinalities_.resize(batch_count);
   267	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(),
   268	                                  device_cardinalities_,
   269	                                  batch_count * sizeof(int),
   270	                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   271	
   272	            int batch_best_cardinality = -1;
   273	            int batch_best_seed = INT_MAX;
   274	#pragma omp parallel
   275	            {
   276	                int thread_cardinality = -1;
   277	                int thread_seed = INT_MAX;
   278	#pragma omp for nowait schedule(static)
   279	                for (int i = 0; i < batch_count; ++i) {
   280	                    const int seed = seeds[offset + static_cast<size_t>(i)];
   281	                    const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[i];
   282	                    if (cardinality > thread_cardinality ||
   283	                        (cardinality == thread_cardinality && seed < thread_seed)) {
   284	                        thread_cardinality = cardinality;
   285	                        thread_seed = seed;
   286	                    }
   287	                }
   288	#pragma omp critical
   289	                {
   290	                    if (thread_cardinality > batch_best_cardinality ||
   291	                        (thread_cardinality == batch_best_cardinality &&
   292	                         thread_seed < batch_best_seed)) {
   293	                        batch_best_cardinality = thread_cardinality;
   294	                        batch_best_seed = thread_seed;
   295	                    }
   296	                }
   297	            }
   298	            if (batch_best_cardinality > best_cardinality ||
   299	                (batch_best_cardinality == best_cardinality &&
   300	                 batch_best_seed < best_seed)) {
   301	                best_cardinality = batch_best_cardinality;
   302	                best_seed = batch_best_seed;
   303	            }
   304	        }
   305	        return {best_cardinality, best_seed};
   306	    }
   307	
   308	    std::vector<int> materializeSeed(int seed, int expected_cardinality,
   309	                                     double threshold) {
   310	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
   311	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   312	        buildCandidateClusters<<<1, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
   313	            device_points_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_, 1, point_count_,
   314	            threshold, device_max_distances_, device_cardinalities_,
   315	            device_members_);
   316	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   317	        int cardinality = 0;
   318	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
   319	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   320	        if (cardinality != expected_cardinality) {
   321	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   322	                         "CUDA candidate cardinality changed from %d to %d\n",
   323	                         expected_cardinality, cardinality);
   324	            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 3);
   325	        }
   326	        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
   327	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
   328	                              cardinality * sizeof(int),
   329	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   330	        return members;
   331	    }
   332	
   333	private:
   334	    int point_count_ = 0;
   335	    size_t capacity_ = 0;
   336	    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
   337	    unsigned char* device_clustered_ = nullptr;
   338	    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
   339	    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
   340	    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
   341	    double* device_max_distances_ = nullptr;
   342	    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
   343	};
   344	
   345	std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
   346	                                  double threshold, int rank, int world_size) {
   347	    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
   348	    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(point_count, 0);
   349	    std::vector<int> unclustered(point_count);
   350	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   351	    for (int i = 0; i < point_count; ++i)
   352	        unclustered[i] = i;
   353	
   354	    const int maximum_local_seeds =
   355	        std::max(1, (point_count + world_size - 1) / world_size);
   356	    CudaCandidateEngine engine(points, maximum_local_seeds);
   357	    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
   358	
   359	    while (!unclustered.empty()) {
   360	        std::vector<int> local_seeds;
   361	        local_seeds.reserve((unclustered.size() + world_size - 1) / world_size);
   362	        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered.size(); i += world_size)
   363	            local_seeds.push_back(unclustered[i]);
   364	
   365	        const auto local_best =
   366	            engine.bestLocalSeed(local_seeds, clustered, threshold);
   367	        int local_pair[2] = {local_best.first, local_best.second};
   368	        int global_pair[2] = {-1, INT_MAX};
   369	        MPI_Allreduce(local_pair, global_pair, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC,
   370	                      MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   371	
   372	        const int best_cardinality = global_pair[0];
   373	        const int best_seed = global_pair[1];
   374	        if (best_cardinality <= 0 || best_seed == INT_MAX)
   375	            break;
   376	
   377	        const auto position = std::lower_bound(unclustered.begin(),
   378	                                               unclustered.end(), best_seed);
   379	        const int owner = static_cast<int>(position - unclustered.begin()) %
   380	                          world_size;
   381	        std::vector<int> best_members(best_cardinality);
   382	        if (rank == owner)
   383	            best_members = engine.materializeSeed(best_seed, best_cardinality,
   384	                                                  threshold);
   385	        MPI_Bcast(best_members.data(), best_cardinality, MPI_INT, owner,
   386	                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   387	
   388	        clusters.push_back({best_members, best_seed});
   389	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   390	        for (int i = 0; i < best_cardinality; ++i)
   391	            clustered[best_members[i]] = 1;
   392	
   393	        unclustered.erase(
   394	            std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),
   395	                           [&clustered](int index) { return clustered[index]; }),
   396	            unclustered.end());
   397	    }
   398	    return clusters;
   399	}
   400	
   401	bool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,
   402	                      const std::vector<Point>& points, double threshold) {
   403	    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);
   404	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)
   405	    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {
   406	        double maximum = 0.0;
   407	        const auto& members = clusters[c].members;
   408	        for (size_t i = 0; i < members.size(); ++i)
   409	            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < members.size(); ++j)
   410	                maximum = std::max(
   411	                    maximum,
   412	                    pointDistance(points[members[i]], points[members[j]]));
   413	        diameters[c] = maximum;
   414	    }
   415	
   416	    bool valid = true;
   417	    std::printf("Validating clusters:\n");
   418	    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {
   419	        if (c < 10)
   420	            std::printf("  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\n",
   450	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   451	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\n");
   452	    std::printf("  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\n");
   453	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   454	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   455	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   456	}
   457	
   458	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   459	    int provided = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   460	    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);
   461	    int rank = 0;
   462	    int world_size = 1;
   463	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   464	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_size);
   465	    if (provided < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   466	        if (rank == 0)
   467	            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide required thread support\n");
   468	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   469	    }
   470	
   471	    int local_rank = 0;
   472	    MPI_Comm shared_communicator;
   473	    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL,
   474	                        &shared_communicator);
   475	    MPI_Comm_rank(shared_communicator, &local_rank);
   476	    MPI_Comm_free(&shared_communicator);
   477	    int device_count = 0;
   478	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
   479	    if (device_count == 0) {
   480	        if (rank == 0)
   481	            std::fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA devices are available\n");
   482	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);
   483	    }
   484	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % device_count));
   485	
   486	    int num_points = 1000;
   487	    double threshold = 2.0;
   488	    bool validate = false;
   489	    bool print_results_requested = false;
   490	    int parse_status = 0;
   491	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   492	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc)
   493	            num_points = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   494	        else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-t") == 0 && i + 1 < argc)
   495	            threshold = std::atof(argv[++i]);
   496	        else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0)
   497	            validate = true;
   498	        else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0)
   499	            print_results_requested = true;
   500	        else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0)
   501	            parse_status = 2;
   502	        else {
   503	            if (rank == 0)
   504	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   505	            parse_status = 1;
   506	        }
   507	    }
   508	    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {
   509	        if (rank == 0)
   510	            std::printf("Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\n",
   511	                        num_points, threshold);
   512	        parse_status = 1;
   513	    }
   514	    if (parse_status != 0) {
   515	        if (rank == 0)
   516	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   517	        MPI_Finalize();
   518	        return parse_status == 2 ? 0 : 1;
   519	    }
   520	
   521	    if (rank == 0) {
   522	        std::printf("QT Clustering Benchmark\n");
   523	        std::printf("Number of points: %d\n", num_points);
   524	        std::printf("Distance threshold: %.2f\n", threshold);
   525	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   526	        std::printf("Parallel configuration: %d MPI ranks, %d OpenMP threads/rank, CUDA\n",
   527	                    world_size, omp_get_max_threads());
   528	    }
   529	
   530	    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);
   531	    if (rank == 0)
   532	        generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);
   533	    MPI_Bcast(points.data(), 2 * num_points, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   534	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   535	    const double start_time = MPI_Wtime();
   536	    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters =
   537	        qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, world_size);
   538	    const double local_elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start_time;
   539	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   540	    MPI_Reduce(&local_elapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0,
   541	               MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   542	
   543	    int exit_status = 0;
   544	    if (rank == 0) {
   545	        const long elapsed_ms = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);
   546	        std::printf("Clustering time: %ld ms\n", elapsed_ms);
   547	        std::printf("Clusters found: %zu\n", clusters.size());
   548	
   549	        int total_clustered = 0;
   550	        int maximum_cluster_size = 0;
   551	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : total_clustered) reduction(max : maximum_cluster_size)
   552	        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {
   553	            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());
   554	            total_clustered += size;
   555	            maximum_cluster_size = std::max(maximum_cluster_size, size);
   556	        }
   557	        const double average_cluster_size = clusters.empty()
   558	                                                ? 0.0
   559	                                                : static_cast<double>(total_clustered) /
   560	                                                      clusters.size();
   561	        std::printf("Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n", total_clustered,
   562	                    num_points, 100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);
   563	        std::printf("Average cluster size: %.2f\n", average_cluster_size);
   564	        std::printf("Maximum cluster size: %d\n", maximum_cluster_size);
   565	        const double safe_elapsed = std::max(elapsed, 1.0e-12);
   566	        std::printf("Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\n",
   567	                    clusters.size() / safe_elapsed, num_points / safe_elapsed);
   568	
   569	        if (print_results_requested) {
   570	            std::vector<double> membership_data(num_points, -1.0);
   571	            for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c)
   572	                for (const int member : clusters[c].members)
   573	                    membership_data[member] = static_cast<double>(c);
   574	            print_results(membership_data, "ClusterMembership");
   575	        }
   576	        if (validate) {
   577	            const bool valid = validateClusters(clusters, points, threshold);
   578	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   579	            exit_status = valid ? 0 : 1;
   580	        }
   581	    }
   582	    MPI_Bcast(&exit_status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   583	    MPI_Finalize();
   584	    return exit_status;
   585	}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterCandidate(double lhs_distance, int lhs,
+                                                 double rhs_distance, int rhs) {
+    return lhs_distance < rhs_distance ||
+           (lhs_distance == rhs_distance && lhs < rhs);

+// A block builds one candidate cluster. Maintaining the maximum distance of
+// every point incrementally reduces candidate construction from cubic to
+// quadratic work. Threads cooperate on distance updates and deterministic
+// minimum selection; independent seeds fill the GPU concurrently.
+__global__ void buildCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                       int seed_count, int point_count,
+                                       double threshold,
+                                       double* __restrict__ max_distances,
+                                       int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                       int* __restrict__ output_members) {
+    const int seed_slot = blockIdx.x;
+    if (seed_slot >= seed_count)
+        return;
+
+    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_slot];
+    double* const seed_distances =
+        max_distances + static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) {
+            seed_distances[candidate] = DBL_MAX;
+        } else {
+            const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[seed].x;
+            const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[seed].y;
+            seed_distances[candidate] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+        }
+    }
+    if (thread == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if (output_members)
+            output_members[0] = seed;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (cardinality < point_count) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            const double candidate_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
+            if (candidate_distance < threshold &&
+                betterCandidate(candidate_distance, candidate,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = candidate_distance;
+                local_index = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
+        reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+            if (thread < stride &&
+                betterCandidate(reduction_distance[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_index[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_distance[thread],

+                reduction_index[thread] = reduction_index[thread + stride];

+                if (output_members)

+                ++cardinality;
+                seed_distances[selected] = DBL_MAX;

         }

-            closest_point = candidate;
+        __syncthreads();

+            break;
+

+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;

+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, int maximum_seed_count)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),

+        size_t free_bytes = 0;

+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t memory_limited = bytes_per_seed == 0

+                                          : (free_bytes / 2) / bytes_per_seed;
+        capacity_ = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(maximum_seed_count),

+        // Fragmentation can make cudaMemGetInfo optimistic. Back off cleanly.
+        cudaError_t allocation_error = cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
+        while (capacity_ > 0) {
+            allocation_error = cudaMalloc(
+                &device_max_distances_, capacity_ * bytes_per_seed);
+            if (allocation_error == cudaSuccess)
+                break;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            capacity_ /= 2;
+        }
+        if (allocation_error != cudaSuccess || capacity_ == 0)
+            CUDA_CHECK(allocation_error);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, points.size() * sizeof(int)));

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterCandidate(double lhs_distance, int lhs,
+                                                 double rhs_distance, int rhs) {
+    return lhs_distance < rhs_distance ||
+           (lhs_distance == rhs_distance && lhs < rhs);
+}
+
+// A block builds one candidate cluster. Maintaining the maximum distance of
+// every point incrementally reduces candidate construction from cubic to
+// quadratic work. Threads cooperate on distance updates and deterministic
+// minimum selection; independent seeds fill the GPU concurrently.
+__global__ void buildCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                       int seed_count, int point_count,
+                                       double threshold,
+                                       double* __restrict__ max_distances,
+                                       int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                       int* __restrict__ output_members) {
+    const int seed_slot = blockIdx.x;
+    if (seed_slot >= seed_count)
+        return;
+
+    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_slot];
+    double* const seed_distances =
+        max_distances + static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) {
+            seed_distances[candidate] = DBL_MAX;
+        } else {
+            const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[seed].x;
+            const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[seed].y;
+            seed_distances[candidate] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+        }
+    }
+    if (thread == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if (output_members)
+            output_members[0] = seed;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (cardinality < point_count) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            const double candidate_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
+            if (candidate_distance < threshold &&
+                betterCandidate(candidate_distance, candidate,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = candidate_distance;
+                local_index = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
+        reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+            if (thread < stride &&
+                betterCandidate(reduction_distance[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_index[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_distance[thread],
+                                reduction_index[thread])) {
+                reduction_distance[thread] = reduction_distance[thread + stride];
+                reduction_index[thread] = reduction_index[thread + stride];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+        }

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, int maximum_seed_count)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_points_, points.size() * sizeof(Point)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_clustered_, points.size()));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(Point),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t memory_limited = bytes_per_seed == 0
+                                          ? 1
+                                          : (free_bytes / 2) / bytes_per_seed;
+        capacity_ = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(maximum_seed_count),
+            std::min<size_t>(memory_limited, 65535)));
+
+        // Fragmentation can make cudaMemGetInfo optimistic. Back off cleanly.
+        cudaError_t allocation_error = cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
+        while (capacity_ > 0) {
+            allocation_error = cudaMalloc(
+                &device_max_distances_, capacity_ * bytes_per_seed);
+            if (allocation_error == cudaSuccess)
+                break;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            capacity_ /= 2;
+        }
+        if (allocation_error != cudaSuccess || capacity_ == 0)
+            CUDA_CHECK(allocation_error);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+    }
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_members_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_max_distances_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
+    }
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;

+    std::pair<int, int> bestLocalSeed(const std::vector<int>& seeds,

+                              clustered.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        int best_cardinality = -1;
+        int best_seed = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < seeds.size(); offset += capacity_) {
+            const int batch_count = static_cast<int>(
+                std::min(capacity_, seeds.size() - offset));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data() + offset,
+                                  batch_count * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+                device_points_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_, batch_count,
+                point_count_, threshold, device_max_distances_,

+            host_cardinalities_.resize(batch_count);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(),
+                                  device_cardinalities_,
+                                  batch_count * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

+            int batch_best_cardinality = -1;

+                for (int i = 0; i < batch_count; ++i) {
+                    const int seed = seeds[offset + static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+                    const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[i];
+                    if (cardinality > thread_cardinality ||
+                        (cardinality == thread_cardinality && seed < thread_seed)) {
+                        thread_cardinality = cardinality;

+                        (thread_cardinality == batch_best_cardinality &&
+                         thread_seed < batch_best_seed)) {
+                        batch_best_cardinality = thread_cardinality;
+                        batch_best_seed = thread_seed;
+                    }
+                }
+            }

+                (batch_best_cardinality == best_cardinality &&
+                 batch_best_seed < best_seed)) {
+                best_cardinality = batch_best_cardinality;
+                best_seed = batch_best_seed;
+            }
+        }
+        return {best_cardinality, best_seed};

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterCandidate(double lhs_distance, int lhs,
+                                                 double rhs_distance, int rhs) {
+    return lhs_distance < rhs_distance ||
+           (lhs_distance == rhs_distance && lhs < rhs);
+}
+
+// A block builds one candidate cluster. Maintaining the maximum distance of
+// every point incrementally reduces candidate construction from cubic to
+// quadratic work. Threads cooperate on distance updates and deterministic
+// minimum selection; independent seeds fill the GPU concurrently.
+__global__ void buildCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                       int seed_count, int point_count,
+                                       double threshold,
+                                       double* __restrict__ max_distances,
+                                       int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                       int* __restrict__ output_members) {
+    const int seed_slot = blockIdx.x;
+    if (seed_slot >= seed_count)
+        return;
+
+    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_slot];
+    double* const seed_distances =
+        max_distances + static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) {
+            seed_distances[candidate] = DBL_MAX;
+        } else {
+            const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[seed].x;
+            const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[seed].y;
+            seed_distances[candidate] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+        }
+    }
+    if (thread == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if (output_members)
+            output_members[0] = seed;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (cardinality < point_count) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            const double candidate_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
+            if (candidate_distance < threshold &&
+                betterCandidate(candidate_distance, candidate,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = candidate_distance;
+                local_index = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
+        reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+            if (thread < stride &&
+                betterCandidate(reduction_distance[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_index[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_distance[thread],
+                                reduction_index[thread])) {
+                reduction_distance[thread] = reduction_distance[thread + stride];
+                reduction_index[thread] = reduction_index[thread + stride];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+        }
+
+        if (thread == 0) {
+            selected = reduction_index[0] == INT_MAX ? -1 : reduction_index[0];
+            if (selected >= 0) {
+                if (output_members)
+                    output_members[cardinality] = selected;
+                ++cardinality;
+                seed_distances[selected] = DBL_MAX;
+            }
         }
-        
-        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best
-        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {
-            min_diameter = max_dist;
-            closest_point = candidate;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (selected < 0)
+            break;
+
+        const Point added = points[selected];
+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            const double old_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
+            if (old_distance != DBL_MAX) {
+                const double dx = points[candidate].x - added.x;
+                const double dy = points[candidate].y - added.y;
+                const double new_distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+                seed_distances[candidate] =
+                    new_distance > old_distance ? new_distance : old_distance;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
     }

+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, int maximum_seed_count)

+            CUDA_CHECK(allocation_error);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));

+// every point incrementally reduces candidate construction from cubic to

+__global__ void buildCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,

+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t memory_limited = bytes_per_seed == 0
+                                          ? 1
+                                          : (free_bytes / 2) / bytes_per_seed;
+        capacity_ = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(maximum_seed_count),
+            std::min<size_t>(memory_limited, 65535)));
+
+        // Fragmentation can make cudaMemGetInfo optimistic. Back off cleanly.
+        cudaError_t allocation_error = cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
+        while (capacity_ > 0) {
+            allocation_error = cudaMalloc(
+                &device_max_distances_, capacity_ * bytes_per_seed);
+            if (allocation_error == cudaSuccess)
+                break;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            capacity_ /= 2;
+        }
+        if (allocation_error != cudaSuccess || capacity_ == 0)
+            CUDA_CHECK(allocation_error);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_members_, points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+    }
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_members_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_max_distances_);
+        cudaFree(device_clustered_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
+    }
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    std::pair<int, int> bestLocalSeed(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                                      const std::vector<unsigned char>& clustered,
+                                      double threshold) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_clustered_, clustered.data(),
+                              clustered.size(), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        int best_cardinality = -1;
+        int best_seed = INT_MAX;
+
+        for (size_t offset = 0; offset < seeds.size(); offset += capacity_) {
+            const int batch_count = static_cast<int>(
+                std::min(capacity_, seeds.size() - offset));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data() + offset,
+                                  batch_count * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+            buildCandidateClusters<<<batch_count, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+                device_points_, device_clustered_, device_seeds_, batch_count,
+                point_count_, threshold, device_max_distances_,
+                device_cardinalities_, nullptr);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+            host_cardinalities_.resize(batch_count);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(),
+                                  device_cardinalities_,
+                                  batch_count * sizeof(int),
+                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+            int batch_best_cardinality = -1;
+            int batch_best_seed = INT_MAX;
+#pragma omp parallel
+            {
+                int thread_cardinality = -1;
+                int thread_seed = INT_MAX;
+#pragma omp for nowait schedule(static)
+                for (int i = 0; i < batch_count; ++i) {
+                    const int seed = seeds[offset + static_cast<size_t>(i)];
+                    const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[i];
+                    if (cardinality > thread_cardinality ||
+                        (cardinality == thread_cardinality && seed < thread_seed)) {
+                        thread_cardinality = cardinality;
+                        thread_seed = seed;
+                    }
+                }
+#pragma omp critical
+                {
+                    if (thread_cardinality > batch_best_cardinality ||
+                        (thread_cardinality == batch_best_cardinality &&
+                         thread_seed < batch_best_seed)) {
+                        batch_best_cardinality = thread_cardinality;
+                        batch_best_seed = thread_seed;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            if (batch_best_cardinality > best_cardinality ||
+                (batch_best_cardinality == best_cardinality &&
+                 batch_best_seed < best_seed)) {
+                best_cardinality = batch_best_cardinality;
+                best_seed = batch_best_seed;
+            }
+        }
+        return {best_cardinality, best_seed};
     }

+            threshold, device_max_distances_, device_cardinalities_,
+            device_members_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        if (cardinality != expected_cardinality) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "CUDA candidate cardinality changed from %d to %d\n",
+                         expected_cardinality, cardinality);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 3);
+        }
+        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);

+                              cardinality * sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

codex
Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version without adding files or changing the executable name.

Key changes:

- CUDA kernel builds candidate clusters concurrently with deterministic tie-breaking.
- Incremental distance tracking reduces candidate construction from cubic to quadratic work.
- MPI distributes seed candidates across ranks and selects the global winner using `MPI_MAXLOC`.
- OpenMP parallelizes host reductions, initialization, statistics, and validation.
- MPI ranks are mapped to node-local CUDA devices.
- GPU memory batching adapts to available device memory.
- CMake now unconditionally requires and links MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA with accelerator architecture support.

Modified:

- [qtclustering.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-medium_hybrid_r2/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:91)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-medium_hybrid_r2/qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt:1)

Verification completed:

- Release build succeeds without warnings.
- Single-rank and two-rank runs produced the identical membership hash: `3f4017c05ffc1734`.
- Default 1,000-point workload passed validation.
- Observed default clustering time on this host: approximately 45 ms.

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterCandidate(double lhs_distance, int lhs,
+                                                 double rhs_distance, int rhs) {
+    return lhs_distance < rhs_distance ||
+           (lhs_distance == rhs_distance && lhs < rhs);
+}
+
+// A block builds one candidate cluster. Maintaining the maximum distance of
+// every point incrementally reduces candidate construction from cubic to
+// quadratic work. Threads cooperate on distance updates and deterministic
+// minimum selection; independent seeds fill the GPU concurrently.
+__global__ void buildCandidateClusters(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                       const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,
+                                       const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                       int seed_count, int point_count,
+                                       double threshold,
+                                       double* __restrict__ max_distances,
+                                       int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                       int* __restrict__ output_members) {
+    const int seed_slot = blockIdx.x;
+    if (seed_slot >= seed_count)
+        return;
+
+    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int selected;
+    __shared__ int cardinality;
+
+    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
+    const int seed = seeds[seed_slot];
+    double* const seed_distances =
+        max_distances + static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count;
+
+    for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+         candidate += blockDim.x) {
+        if (clustered[candidate] || candidate == seed) {
+            seed_distances[candidate] = DBL_MAX;
+        } else {
+            const double dx = points[candidate].x - points[seed].x;
+            const double dy = points[candidate].y - points[seed].y;
+            seed_distances[candidate] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+        }
+    }
+    if (thread == 0) {
+        cardinality = 1;
+        if (output_members)
+            output_members[0] = seed;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    while (cardinality < point_count) {
+        double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+        int local_index = INT_MAX;
+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            const double candidate_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
+            if (candidate_distance < threshold &&
+                betterCandidate(candidate_distance, candidate,
+                                local_distance, local_index)) {
+                local_distance = candidate_distance;
+                local_index = candidate;
+            }
+        }
+        reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
+        reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        for (int stride = blockDim.x / 2; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {
+            if (thread < stride &&
+                betterCandidate(reduction_distance[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_index[thread + stride],
+                                reduction_distance[thread],
+                                reduction_index[thread])) {
+                reduction_distance[thread] = reduction_distance[thread + stride];
+                reduction_index[thread] = reduction_index[thread + stride];
+            }
+            __syncthreads();
+        }
+
+        if (thread == 0) {
+            selected = reduction_index[0] == INT_MAX ? -1 : reduction_index[0];
+            if (selected >= 0) {
+                if (output_members)
+                    output_members[cardinality] = selected;
+                ++cardinality;
+                seed_distances[selected] = DBL_MAX;
+            }
         }
-        
-        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best
-        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {
-            min_diameter = max_dist;
-            closest_point = candidate;
+        __syncthreads();
+        if (selected < 0)
+            break;
+
+        const Point added = points[selected];
+        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+             candidate += blockDim.x) {
+            const double old_distance = seed_distances[candidate];
+            if (old_distance != DBL_MAX) {
+                const double dx = points[candidate].x - added.x;
+                const double dy = points[candidate].y - added.y;
+                const double new_distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+                seed_distances[candidate] =
+                    new_distance > old_distance ? new_distance : old_distance;
+            }
         }
+        __syncthreads();
     }

+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, int maximum_seed_count)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())) {

+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_seed = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t memory_limited = bytes_per_seed == 0

+        capacity_ = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(

+        cudaError_t allocation_error = cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
+        while (capacity_ > 0) {
+            allocation_error = cudaMalloc(
+                &device_max_distances_, capacity_ * bytes_per_seed);
+            if (allocation_error == cudaSuccess)
+                break;
+            cudaGetLastError();
+            capacity_ /= 2;
+        }
+        if (allocation_error != cudaSuccess || capacity_ == 0)
+            CUDA_CHECK(allocation_error);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_seeds_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&device_cardinalities_, capacity_ * sizeof(int)));

Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version without adding files or changing the executable name.

Key changes:

- CUDA kernel builds candidate clusters concurrently with deterministic tie-breaking.
- Incremental distance tracking reduces candidate construction from cubic to quadratic work.
- MPI distributes seed candidates across ranks and selects the global winner using `MPI_MAXLOC`.
- OpenMP parallelizes host reductions, initialization, statistics, and validation.
- MPI ranks are mapped to node-local CUDA devices.
- GPU memory batching adapts to available device memory.
- CMake now unconditionally requires and links MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA with accelerator architecture support.
